finding: One shot runs its weapon's warhead list in YAML node order (no sort): damage, smudge, sprite and sound, shake, flash. A warhead with Delay above zero is deferred by ticks. Verdict STRONG; adapt the chain shape, clean-room (GPL-3.0; Westwood content).

Screen shake is a sine and cosine on tick count, clamped multiplier plus or minus 3, inverse-square falloff from impact to view centre, capped at 10. Death shake is 10 ticks at intensity 1. Defect: shake switches off in one step at expiry; fix by decaying the tail.

A flash blinks on alternate interval ticks (default 2 blinks, 4 ticks). A new flash on the same actor replaces the old one (last hit wins). Defect: screen flash blend divides by the fixed Length (20), so a 5-tick flash peaks at 0.2; fix with the set duration. No hit stop and no unit knockback in the donor; recoil is a barrel kick only.

Order of one melee hit: block or parry, health change, poise drain (energy decides poise or extra health), knockback effects, then next pass a stagger state from poise thresholds 50, 30, 15, 5, with poise reset and an immunity window of stagger length plus 1.0 s. Verdict STRONG; the stagger ladder replaces hit stop. Clean-room (GPL-3.0).

Stagger states: Interrupted 0.4 s at 80 percent speed; Stunned 0.7 s at 50 percent; Dazed 1.5 s at 20 percent; KnockedDown 3.0 s with impulse 10.0. Defect: Stunned doc says knocked back but code has no impulse for it. Defect: sound cooldown is not applied on the client outcome path, and the threshold field doubles as subtitle duration.

Client feedback is outcome-driven: Damage, Death (40 particles, 400 to 500 ms), Block and Parry (10 sparks, 200 ms), and per-state stagger sounds (24 hit and stagger files in 8 keys). Floating number flashes for 0.1 s. Defect: poise regen rate is never reset, so regen restarts fast after a hit. Flashing-lights setting exists; it must also cover our blink.
